text: 虚伪，十分的虚伪。
en: Hypocritical, utterly hypocritical.

text: 1.你只要问兄弟们最近忙啥呢，一般都回“瞎忙！
en: 1. Whenever you ask the lads what they've been busy with lately, they'll generally reply, “Just busy with nothing!

text: 再问：“瞎忙啥？
en: Ask again: “Busy with what?

text: 回：“就还是以前那些破事！
en: They reply: “Still the same old rubbish!

text: 反正你是不知道他忙啥，靠啥发财呢。
en: Anyway, you'll never know what he's busy with or how he makes his money.

text: 2.你只要问兄弟们最近效益咋样，一般都回“不好做啊！
en: 2. Whenever you ask the lads how business has been, they'll generally reply, “Hard going, I tell you!

text: 安慰：“辛苦啊！
en: You comfort them: “Tough, eh!

text: 会被反安慰：“大环境不好，都不容易啊”
en: Only to be comforted back: “The wider economy's poor, nobody's having it easy.”

text: 反正他具体有多辛苦，咱也不知道啊。
en: Anyway, just how hard he's actually working, we've no idea.

text: 3.你只要问最近换工作了吗，一般都回“准备马上换。
en: 3. Whenever you ask if he's changed jobs lately, he'll generally reply, “About to, any minute now.

text: 再问“两年前不是就说要换吗？
en: Ask again: “Didn't you say you were going to change two years ago?

text: 对方会说出实话“找不到下家。
en: He'll tell the truth: “Can't find anywhere to go.

text: 反正他到底是图安逸不走，还是弱的找不到下家，你是根本不知道。
en: Anyway, whether he's staying put for an easy life or is too useless to find a new post, you'll never know.

text: 4.悄咪咪问已婚男人和媳妇过的咋样，一般都回“还那样。
en: 4. When you quietly ask a married man how things are with the wife, he'll generally reply, “Same as ever.

text: ”，如果你猥琐的笑笑。
en: ”, and if you give a lecherous little smile.

text: 对方会回“两星期才一次，能咋样！
en: He'll reply: “Only once a fortnight, what can you expect!

text: 反驳“你们处的有那么好？
en: You retort: “Things that good between you two?

text: 对方会说出实话：“其实一个月才一次。
en: He'll tell the truth: “Truth is, only once a month.

text: 反正他打死也不会说其实半年一次。
en: Anyway, he'd never admit it's actually only twice a year.

text: 反正，真男人，真中年男人，真虚伪！
en: Anyway, real men, real middle-aged men, truly hypocritical!

text: 他的辛苦，他的脆弱，他的无奈，他的痛苦，你是不会知道的。
en: His toil, his fragility, his helplessness, his pain — you will never know.

text: 图文升级版
en: Enhanced illustrated edition

text: 反正你是不知道他忙啥，靠啥发财呢…
en: Anyway, you'll never know what he's busy with or how he makes his money…

text: 反正他具体有多辛苦多不容易，还有工资到底发没发，咱也不知道啊…
en: Anyway, just how hard he's working and how rough it's been, or whether his wages have even been paid, we've no idea…

text: 毕竟曾经身家1655亿的中国首富，最近也发不起工资了，欠薪5个月，遭400员工组团讨薪。
en: After all, even China's former richest man, once worth 165.5 billion, recently couldn't make payroll, owing five months of wages and facing 400 employees banding together to demand their pay.

text: 反正他到底是图安逸不走，还是弱的找不到下家，你是根本不知道…
en: Anyway, whether he's staying put for an easy life or is too useless to find a new post, you'll never really know…

text: 毕竟现在这个地方虽然是坑，说不定下个地方是雷呢？
好多半年前裸辞的“勇敢的强者”，现在还裸着呢，他们有的躲在咖啡馆，有的躲在公园，有的哭晕在厕所，反正就是不敢回家。
en: After all, this place may be a pit, but who's to say the next won't be a mine?

Plenty of those “brave souls” who handed in their notice with nothing lined up half a year ago are still jobless — some hiding in cafés, some in parks, some weeping in the toilets — anyway, they just daren't go home.

text: 反正他打死也不会说其实“半年一次”…
en: Anyway, he'd never say it's actually “twice a year”…

text: 问的人也对自己“一年一次”这个秘密守口如瓶！
en: And the one asking guards his own secret of “once a year” with his life!

text: 当然，也有好多“至今是无”的神秘存在，且行且珍惜吧！
en: Of course, there are also plenty of mysterious types who are “still at zero” — make the most of it while it lasts!

text: 注意称谓：是问兄弟，不是随便问个人。
en: Mind the form of address: this is asking your brothers, not just anyone.

text: 那些男人，那些中年老男人，即使面对哥们，也不坦诚，也会“虚伪”的假装坚强，藏下困难。
en: Those men, those old middle-aged men, won't be honest even with their mates — they'll “hypocritically” pretend to be strong and hide their troubles.

text: 他也许不是不告诉你忙什么，不是不告诉你效益如何，不是准备马上换工作，而是可能。
en: Perhaps he's not hiding what he's busy with, not hiding how business is, not about to change jobs any minute — but perhaps.

text: 已经失业了。
en: He's already unemployed.

text: 说又虚又萎那个站住别走！
en: You there, the one who's both false and feeble — stop right there, don't go!

text: ps：本人是知乎重度用户，18年在知乎看了18万个回答，1.5亿字。
en: PS: I'm a heavy user of Zhihu; in 2018 I read 180,000 answers on Zhihu, some 150 million characters.

text: 作为知乎点赞小能手，在知乎海量内容里筛选出一批好内容进行点赞，当然，自己也写点东西，大家需要的话关注我知乎。
en: As a bit of a Zhihu upvoting whizz, I sift through Zhihu's vast content to pick out good material to upvote; of course, I write a bit myself too, so follow me on Zhihu if you like.

text: 今年是我第三个本命年，36周岁，人到中年，身边已失业，将失业，怕失业，想失业的人群越来越多。
en: This year is my third zodiac birth year; I've just turned 36. Middle-aged now, I find more and more people around me are unemployed, about to be, frightened of being, or even wanting to be unemployed.

text: 我做了一个公众号：
en: I've started a WeChat official account:

text: ［失业的中年人］
en: ］The Unemployed Middle-Aged＾

text: 希望大家抱团、取暖、互助。
en: I hope we can huddle together, keep warm, and help one another.

text: 成年男人拼命努力，拼命工作，不过是为了得到他随着年龄增长而应该有的尊重。
en: Grown men strive and work themselves to the bone simply to earn the respect they feel they deserve as they grow older.

text: 可惜，大部分男人最后都得不到。
en: A pity, then, that most men end up getting none of it.

text: 有可能是在领导，同事面前，在自己的女人面前，也有可能在自己的孩子面前。
en: It may be before their boss or colleagues, before their own woman, or possibly before their own children.

text: 不是男人天生追求事业，而是他害怕不这么做后，尊严，爱情，亲情都会离他而去。
en: It's not that men are born chasing career success, but that he fears that if he doesn't, his dignity, love, and family affection will all desert him.

text: 尤其当他知道，爱情成功的秘诀之一是成为另一半仰望的对象时，他不敢不努力，可惜常常结果是他努力的速度比不上另一半的眼光。
en: Especially once he learns that one secret to a successful romance is becoming the object of his partner's admiration, he dares not slack off — yet often, sadly, the speed of his effort can't keep up with his partner's rising standards.

text: 除此之外，还有不少人因为缺少陪伴，婚姻破碎。
en: Beyond that, many others lose their marriages through a lack of companionship.

text: 这就是真实的男人。
en: This is the real man.

text: 外表坚强，内心惶恐，在世界上疲惫着活着。
en: Strong on the outside, anxious within, weary survivors in this world.

text: 可以看做是一份中年男人的出轨报道。
en: This can be read as a report on middle-aged men's affairs.

text: 年过四十，忽然发觉周围出现越来越多有婚外情的中年人，他们像雨后的笋，一个接一个从隐藏的地下露出了头角。
en: Past forty, I suddenly noticed more and more middle-aged people around me having affairs, springing up like bamboo shoots after rain, one after another breaking through from their hidden underground.

text: 这有些让我惊讶，等见得多了，就逐渐变得熟视无睹。
en: This rather surprised me at first, but after seeing enough of it I gradually grew numb to it.

text: 也许对一些男人来说，当中年的感情生活开始变得像白开水一样寡淡无味，他对婚外情感的免疫力就大大降低了。
en: Perhaps for some men, once their middle-aged emotional life turns as bland and tasteless as plain boiled water, their immunity to extramarital feelings drops sharply.

text: 一个周末的晚上，我正坐在沙发上看电视，忽然接到同事赵刚的电话，他语气有些焦急，匆匆叮嘱我：“要是我媳妇给你打电话，你就说今晚我和你在某某酒店一起吃饭。
en: One weekend evening, I was sitting on the sofa watching telly when I suddenly got a call from my colleague Gang Zhao. Sounding rather anxious, he hurriedly told me, “If my wife rings you, just say you and I are having dinner together tonight at some hotel or other.

text: 我没问他原因，一口答应下来，联想到他这段日子老在办公室神神秘秘背着人接电话的样子，我断定他有外遇了，今晚肯定是跟别的女人在一起，不然不会让我来协助他欺骗自己的老婆。
en: I didn't ask why, simply agreed, and putting it together with how he'd been sneaking off to take calls behind people's backs in the office lately, I was certain he was having an affair — he must be with another woman tonight, or he'd never have got me to help deceive his own wife.

text: 周一上班碰面，我俩心照不宣，谁也没再提这事。
en: When we met at work on Monday, we were tacitly in agreement and neither mentioned it again.

text: 赵刚原本是我认为不会发生婚外情的那种人，他为人低调，从没听说过生活作风上有什么问题，她妻子也是很贤惠的那种女人，两口子养着俩孩子，刚刚当选了单位的“幸福家庭”。
en: Gang Zhao was the sort of person I'd have thought would never have an affair — modest, with never a whisper of any misconduct, and his wife a thoroughly virtuous woman. The couple were raising two children and had just been named the unit's “Happy Family”.

text: 一个月后的一天晚上，我带老婆孩子来到一家餐厅吃饭，在餐厅门口迎面碰上赵刚。
en: One evening a month later, I took my wife and child to a restaurant for a meal and bumped straight into Gang Zhao at the door.

text: 我跟他打招呼，却感觉他神情好像有些不自然。
en: I greeted him, but sensed something slightly awkward in his manner.

text: 这时一个看起来40岁左右的女人从餐厅里走出来，亲热地挽起赵刚的胳膊，说道：“老公，我们走吧。
en: Just then a woman who looked about forty came out of the restaurant, took Gang Zhao's arm affectionately and said, “Darling, let's go.

text: 老公？
en: Darling?

text: 我一脸愕然，这女人并不是赵刚的妻子，为什么会叫他老公？
en: I was utterly baffled — this woman wasn't Gang Zhao's wife, so why call him darling?

text: 赵刚更加不自然，尴尬地冲我一笑，匆匆带着女人走了。
en: Gang Zhao grew even more ill at ease, gave me an embarrassed smile, and hurried off with the woman.

text: 妻子看到了我的愕然，问我：“怎么了？
en: My wife noticed my bewilderment and asked me, “What's wrong?

text: 我告诉她：“这个女的不是他老婆。
en: I told her, “That woman isn't his wife.

text: 妻子“喔”了一声，一副见怪不怪的样子。
en: My wife gave a little “Oh” and looked thoroughly unsurprised.

text: 也难怪，这种事现在太普遍，身边一大堆，谁还能奇怪呢。
en: No wonder, really — this sort of thing is so common now, everywhere around us, who could still be shocked?

text: 妻子问道：“他很有钱吗？
en: My wife asked, “Is he very rich?

text: 我说：“跟我一样领工资，能有多少钱。
en: I said, “He's on a salary like me, how much could he have.

text: 妻子说：“没钱这女的图他的啥？
en: My wife said, “With no money, what's she after from him?

text: 吃饭的时候，赵刚给我打来电话，嘱咐我：“今天的事别跟人说，替我保密，拜托！
en: While we were eating, Gang Zhao rang me and asked, “Don't tell anyone about today, keep it secret for me, please!

text: 我调侃他：“保密没问题，不过你小子挺有能耐，家里红旗不倒，外边红旗飘飘啊！
en: I teased him: “Keeping quiet's no problem, but you've got some skill — the red flag at home stays flying while red flags flutter all around outside, eh!

text: 赵刚在电话里苦笑：“兄弟，别笑话我了，这不是没办法嘛。
en: Gang Zhao gave a bitter laugh on the phone: “Brother, don't mock me, it's just that I've no choice.

text: ”听起来他好像有苦衷。
en: ” — he sounded as though he had his own troubles.

text: 那次喝完酒，我跟赵刚顺着马路散了会儿步，一边走一边聊。
en: After that drinking session, Gang Zhao and I strolled along the road a while, chatting as we went.

text: “你说我是不是个傻瓜？
en: “Do you think I'm a fool?

text: ”他忽然冒出一句。
en: ” — he suddenly blurted out.

text: “咋了？
en: “What's up?

text: 怎么这么问？
en: Why d'you ask?

text: ”我问。
en: ” I asked.

text: “那个女人，就是那天你见到的那个，她是我当年的女友。
en: “That woman — the one you saw that day — she was my girlfriend back then.

text: ”他说道。
en: ” he said.

text: “哦，你们渊源很深啊！
en: “Oh, so you two have a deep history!

text: ”我又调侃他。
en: ” I teased him again.

text: “我就是不明白，她为什么就那么吸引我？
en: “I just don't understand, why is she still so attractive to me?

text: 当年，她可是并没有一心一意地对我。
en: Back then, she certainly wasn't devoted to me.

text: 我和赵刚走了一路，他讲了一路他和那个女人的事，从他的叙述中，我似乎看到了一个十几年前的场景：
en: Gang Zhao and I walked the whole way as he talked the whole way about that woman and him; from his account I seemed to see a scene from over a decade before:

text: 赵刚不要命地骑着摩托车在车流中穿梭飞驰，好几次差点刮碰到汽车也全然不顾，他的脑袋里只有一个心思，撵上前面的公交车，截住车上的那对男女。
en: Gang Zhao rode his motorbike recklessly through the traffic, weaving at speed, several times nearly clipping cars yet caring nothing; his only thought was to catch up with the bus ahead and stop the young man and woman on board.

text: 二十分钟后，赵刚撵上了刚停站下客的公交车，他把摩托车往路边一歪，快步赶过去，挡住了那对青年男女的去路，女青年脸色马上就变了。
en: Twenty minutes later Gang Zhao caught up with the bus that had just stopped to let passengers off; he leaned the motorbike against the kerb, hurried over and blocked the young couple's path — the young woman's face changed at once.

text: 男青年疑惑的问：“你是谁？
en: The young man asked, puzzled, “Who are you?

text: 要干什么？
en: What do you want?

text: 赵刚气血往头上涌，他指着女青年不管不顾地说道：“我是谁你问问她，她的肚子里怀着我的孩子。
en: Blood rushed to Gang Zhao's head; pointing at the young woman without a care, he said, “Ask her who I am — she's carrying my child.

text: 这个场景中的女青年就是我那天见到的那个女人，是赵刚十几年前的女友，当时却脚踩两只船。
en: The young woman in that scene was the very woman I'd seen that day — Gang Zhao's girlfriend of over ten years before, though back then she'd been two-timing.

text: 那次事件之后，她和赵刚断绝了来往。
en: After that incident, she and Gang Zhao cut off all contact.

text: 我问：“既然这样，你们现在怎么又在一起了？
en: I asked, “If that's the case, how come you're together again now?

text: 赵刚回答得有些无奈：“我说不清楚为什么，不论以前是怎样，至今我都无法拒绝她对我的吸引，一年前我俩又联系上了，她离婚了。
en: Gang Zhao answered rather helplessly, “I can't explain why; no matter what happened before, to this day I can't resist her pull on me. We got back in touch a year ago — she'd got divorced.

text: 我问：“那你打算怎么办？
en: I asked, “So what do you plan to do?

text: 赵刚说：“我也不知道和她能维持这种关系到什么时候，也许很快就结束了，我经常有负罪感，觉得对不起我老婆。
en: Gang Zhao said, “I don't know how long this relationship with her can last either — maybe it'll end soon. I often feel guilty, like I've let my wife down.

text: “你老婆很善良，你好自为之吧。
en: “Your wife is a good woman; you'd best mind your own conduct.

text: ”我说。
en: ” I said.

text: 我知道赵刚并没有很快结束这段婚外情，后来他借调到上级单位半年，我很长时间没再关心他的这件事。
en: I knew Gang Zhao didn't end the affair quickly; later he was seconded to a higher-level unit for half a year, and for a long while I stopped keeping track of his business.

text: 身边同事的婚外情依然不时冒出来一个，因为司空见惯，我对此类事失去了关注的兴趣，直到见识了另一个同事老张在这方面的超人才能。
en: Affairs among colleagues around me still surfaced now and then, but having grown so used to them I'd lost interest in such matters — until I witnessed the superhuman talent of another colleague, Old Zhang, in this regard.

text: 老张马上五十岁了，除了样貌比年龄略显年轻，身材还没走样，身上残留了一些年轻时的痞气外，实在也没看出有什么特别之处。
en: Old Zhang was nearly fifty; apart from looking a bit younger than his years, still being in shape, and carrying a trace of the rough manner of his youth, there was really nothing especially remarkable about him.

text: 那段时间，我俩在同一个工程项目上工作，没觉得他业务怎么样，搞婚外情方面却让我刮目相看。
en: During that period the two of us worked on the same engineering project; I didn't think much of his professional ability, but in the matter of affairs he rather opened my eyes.

text: 空闲时，老张特喜欢给我讲他搞到手的女人，说现在跟他保持那种关系的女人有五六个，而且都是良家妇女。
en: In his spare time Old Zhang loved to tell me about the women he'd got his hands on, saying there were five or six women still in that sort of relationship with him, and all of them decent, married women.

text: 怕我不相信，老张每给我讲完一个女人，就当我面开着免提给这个女人打一个言语轻佻的电话，让我知道他不是在吹牛。
en: Afraid I wouldn't believe him, after telling me about each woman Old Zhang would, right in front of me, put the phone on speaker and make a flirtatious call to her, to show me he wasn't boasting.

text: 我对老张的行为感到不齿，同时又很奇怪他是怎么跟这些女人搭上的，老张轻描淡写地对我说：“其实女人男人都一样，她们心里也不是不想这些，要跟她们搭上很容易。
en: I found Old Zhang's behaviour contemptible, yet was curious how he'd got together with these women; Old Zhang said to me lightly, “Truth is, women and men are the same — deep down they're not unwilling either, and it's easy enough to get with them.

text: ”对他的话我并不能苟同。
en: ” I couldn't agree with that.

text: 老张毫不讳言，他找女人是赤裸裸地为了寻求性刺激。
en: Old Zhang made no secret that he sought out women purely and nakedly for sexual thrills.

text: 我说：“你直接去找小姐不就完了？
en: I said, “Why not just go straight to a prostitute?

text: ”他说：“小姐和这种正经女人的感觉是完全不一样的。
en: ” he said, “The feeling with a prostitute and with this kind of proper woman is completely different.

text: 说实话，以男人的眼光来看，我实在不明白老张哪方面吸引了这些女人，况且他也没什么钱，那这些女人究竟是为了什么呢？
en: To be honest, speaking as a man, I really can't see what about Old Zhang attracted these women, and he wasn't rich either — so what on earth were these women after?

text: 我见过老张的一个情人，在离他家很远的一条大街上，老张和这个看起来还很年轻的女孩紧挨着走在一起。
en: I once saw one of Old Zhang's lovers — on a busy street far from his home, Old Zhang and this girl who still looked very young walked along arm in arm.

text: 猛不丁碰到我，老张很坦然，我反倒觉得有些尴尬。
en: Caught off guard by meeting me, Old Zhang was quite unabashed, while I felt a little awkward instead.

text: 这个女孩老张给我讲过，从18岁就跟老张好，到如今已经7年了。
en: This girl Old Zhang had told me about — she'd been with him since she was eighteen, and that's seven years now.

text: 老张说这些情人里面，最在乎的就是她。
en: Old Zhang said that of all his lovers, she was the one he cared about most.

text: 后来我调侃老张：“等她找了对象，你也要光荣退役了吧，再这么霸着人家就不好了。
en: Later I teased Old Zhang: “Once she finds a partner, you'll be honourably retired too, won't you — it wouldn't be right to keep monopolising her like this.

text: 老张说：“到时候再看，估计她还是离不了我，她现在找对象总是拿我作比较，相了几次亲，都看不中。
en: Old Zhang said, “We'll see when the time comes; I reckon she still can't leave me. When she looks for a partner now she always compares them with me, and she's been on a few matchmaking meetings but fancied none of them.

text: 我说：“那你更要赶紧退出了，你老在她的生活里，会给她造成干扰。
en: I said, “Then you should withdraw all the sooner — you lingering in her life will only disturb her.

text: 老张笑笑：“最近她去相亲见面，我都躲在一边替她把关，碰到好的，我就劝劝她，要是成了，以后还跟我来不来往，就随她吧。
en: Old Zhang smiled: “Lately when she goes to meet a match, I hide to one side and vet them for her; if one's decent I'll encourage her, and if it works out, whether she keeps in touch with me afterwards is up to her.

text: 两个月后我问老张：“她的对象找得怎么样了？
en: Two months later I asked Old Zhang, “How's she getting on finding someone?

text: 老张说：“谈了一个，双方都比较满意，昨天到男方家上门见父母去了。
en: Old Zhang said, “She's seeing one chap; both sides are fairly pleased, and yesterday she went to his family's home to meet his parents.

text: 我问：“那你呢，什么时候退出？
en: I asked, “And you — when will you bow out?

text: 老张刚要回答，忽然来了电话，正是那个女孩打来的。
en: Old Zhang was about to answer when a call came in — it was that girl.

text: 老张也不避讳我，两人在电话里说了几句话，就约好了明天去开房。
en: Old Zhang didn't mind my being there; the two exchanged a few words on the phone and arranged to meet in a hotel room tomorrow.

text: 接完电话，老张冲我一乐，说：“明天是情人节，还得给老婆买束花，得把老婆也哄好。
en: After the call, Old Zhang grinned at me and said, “Tomorrow's Valentine's Day, I've still got to buy the wife some flowers and keep her sweet too.

text: 我真心地骂了他一句：“你真是无耻到家了！
en: I sincerely cursed him: “You are utterly shameless!

text: 作为一个刚步入中年的男人，我也经历过婚外情的诱惑。
en: As a man who'd only just entered middle age, I too have experienced the temptation of an affair.

text: 结婚十年，孩子成了家庭的重点，拉着妻子的手，有了左手拉右手的感觉。
en: Ten years married, the child became the centre of the family; holding my wife's hand felt like holding my left hand with my right.

text: 一次偶然的机会，我碰到了初恋女友。
en: By chance one time, I ran into my first love.

text: 当年，我俩一见钟情，但她的家庭坚决不同意我们交往，因为观念老旧的父母很早就给她和世交家的男孩定了一门亲，她本来已经接受，遇到我后开始激烈反抗。
en: Back then we fell for each other at first sight, but her family firmly opposed us being together, because her old-fashioned parents had long ago arranged a match for her with the son of a family friend. She'd accepted it at first, but after meeting me began to resist fiercely.

text: 半年后我开始刻意地躲避她，直到不再跟她有联系，因为我觉得累了。
en: Half a year later I began deliberately avoiding her, until we lost contact entirely, because I'd grown tired.

text: 后来我听说她以断绝关系为要挟，迫使父母同意解除了婚约。
en: Later I heard that, threatening to cut all ties, she forced her parents to agree to cancel the betrothal.

text: 这次相遇，她非常惊讶非常开心，要了我的联系方式。
en: At this reunion she was astonished and delighted, and asked for my contact details.

text: 后来，她经常联系我，那天约我晚上一起吃饭，我跟妻子说有应酬，去赴了约。
en: Afterwards she often got in touch; that day she asked me out to dinner in the evening, and I told my wife I had a work engagement and went.

text: 坐在昏暗的卡间里，她幽幽地对我说：“我过得不好。
en: Sitting in the dim private booth, she said to me softly, “I'm not doing well.

text: 我问：“怎么了？
en: I asked, “What's wrong?

text: 他对你不好吗？
en: Isn't he good to you?

text: 她回答：“他对我很好，但是我一直忘不了你。
en: She replied, “He's very good to me, but I've never been able to forget you.

text: 我沉默了，不知道该说什么。
en: I fell silent, not knowing what to say.

text: 吃完饭，我开车送她到她家楼下，她依依不舍不愿下车，良久后对我说：“他出差了，家里没人，你上去坐坐吧，我想让你多陪我一会儿。
en: After the meal I drove her to beneath her building; reluctant to get out, she lingered, and after a long while said to me, “He's away on a trip, there's no one at home — come up for a bit, I want you to keep me company a little longer.

text: 我的心“怦怦”跳得厉害，犹豫着上不上去。
en: My heart was pounding wildly, and I hesitated over whether to go up.

text: 说实话，那一刻我是想上去的，我也知道上去肯定会发生些什么。
en: To be honest, in that moment I wanted to go up, and I knew that going up would surely lead to something.

text: 但我还是压制了自己的欲望，拥抱了一下她，然后告诉她：“不早了，我不上去了。
en: But I suppressed my desire, hugged her once, and then told her, “It's late, I won't come up.

text: 回到家，孩子已经睡了。
en: Back home, the child was already asleep.

text: 妻子见我回来，转身拿出一件新夹克，开心地递给我说：“你试试合不合适，不合适我明天去换。
en: My wife saw me return, turned and fetched a new jacket, and handed it to me happily: “Try it on, see if it fits; if not I'll exchange it tomorrow.

text: 妻子很喜欢给我买衣服，她自己却不舍得买，我经常埋怨她不该给我买这么多衣服，浪费钱，她却总是乐此不疲。
en: My wife loves buying me clothes but is loath to buy any for herself; I often grumble that she shouldn't buy me so many, wasting money, yet she never tires of it.

text: 试完衣服，我进了自己的卧室，发现妻子已经给我换洗了床单，白天为我晒好的被子软软的，散发着阳光的暖香。
en: After trying it on, I went into our bedroom and found my wife had already changed the sheets; the quilt she'd aired for me in the daytime was soft and gave off the warm scent of sunshine.

text: 我忽然感觉到一种满足，又庆幸自己今天做对了，因为我没有残忍地打碎妻子的世界。
en: I suddenly felt a kind of contentment, and was glad I'd done the right thing today, for I had not cruelly shattered my wife's world.

text: 半年后，赵刚借调期结束刚回单位不久，他的婚外情就暴露了，不过不是我给他暴露的，是他的情人去找他的妻子摊了牌，要她让位。
en: Half a year later, soon after Gang Zhao's secondment ended and he'd just returned to the unit, his affair came to light — though not through me; his lover went to his wife and laid her cards on the table, demanding she step aside.

text: 赵刚不想这样，但已经把控不了局面。
en: Gang Zhao hadn't wanted this, but could no longer control the situation.

text: 赵刚的妻子是个比较软弱的人，尽管受到了难以忍受的屈辱，她还是希望能够保住自己的家庭，于是带着俩孩子哭哭啼啼到单位找了领导。
en: Gang Zhao's wife was a rather timid woman; though she suffered unbearable humiliation, she still hoped to save her family, and so, in tears with the two children in tow, went to the unit to see the leadership.

text: 在领导面前，赵刚答应把事情解决好，跟情人断绝关系。
en: Before the leadership, Gang Zhao promised to sort things out and cut ties with his lover.

text: 谁知仅仅过了一周，就发生了赵刚的情人驾车在马路上故意别倒赵刚妻子的事，一时间成了我们这个小城市的新闻。
en: Yet barely a week later, Gang Zhao's lover deliberately forced Gang Zhao's wife off the road with her car — and for a time it became the talk of our little city.

text: 这件事发生后，赵刚终究还是和妻子离了婚。
en: After this incident, Gang Zhao ultimately divorced his wife.

text: 赵刚受到了人们的谴责，他自觉没法再在单位待下去，于是很快辞了职，去北京应聘了工作。
en: Gang Zhao was condemned by others; feeling he could no longer stay at the unit, he soon resigned and went to Beijing to take up a job.

text: 全民故事计划的第92个故事：《我那些正在婚外恋的中年同事们》
en: The 92nd story of Quanmin Story Project: “My Middle-Aged Colleagues Who Are Having Affairs”

en: Author: Chang He, a low-ranking cadre in a state-owned enterprise
